# Orvio 0.15

- First start: only "Create your profile"; after saving you go straight in. "Who's watching?" from the next start on.
- Updating keeps your existing profile and history; you are not asked to make a new one.
- Home banner shows straight away and switches to the best-rated picks once ratings are in.
- Playlist refresh retries a failed part once, and a failed background refresh no longer shows a red error while your saved list still works.
